scope: Authored CVA components/modules/scene catalog/renderers and their scoped styles. Original Forma engine, third-party fonts, game assets, templates, exporter and fixture content are excluded from rendering.

files.adaptation: Use the validated per-call local media registry; omit authored demo asset registration.

Initialize the canonical scene catalog from three explicit empty records. Make the source-only copper-mirror demo preload optional when no FW_STORY is provided; no fixture source/assets are loaded or rendered.

adapterContract: CVA_MODULES.create → explicit empty fields → actual game content → CVA_MODULES.normalizeDocument → CVA_RENDERER.renderBlock. Isolated per-call local registry/context.
normalizationNote: Only CRLF becomes LF; no other whitespace, BOM, bare CR or content is normalized. sourceSha256 and patchSha256 retain exact original adoption bytes. sourceNormalizedSha256, vendorSha256 and licenseSha256 pin LF UTF-8 content. sourceLineEndings reproduces the original source and license byte hashes.
